    AI Overview
    The 2026 NHL Stanley Cup Playoffs are scheduled to begin on April 18, 2026. While the final matchups are being decided during the final week of the regular season, early clinching scenarios suggest key matchups in the East (e.g., CAR-OTT, BUF-BOS) and West (e.g., COL-NSH, DAL-MIN). 
    Key 2026 Playoff Picture Details: 
    • Start Date: April 18, 2026.
    • Current Projected Matchups (as of April 9, 2026):
      • East: Carolina vs. Ottawa, Pittsburgh vs. Philadelphia, Buffalo vs. Boston, Montreal vs. Tampa Bay.
      • West: Colorado vs. Nashville, Dallas vs. Minnesota, Edmonton vs. Utah, Vegas vs. Anaheim.
    • Clinching Status: Teams like Colorado, Dallas, and Minnesota have secured spots, while Eastern wild-card spots are still being finalized with Ottawa and Philadelphia in contention. 
    Watchful Information: 
    • Final Regular Season Games: The regular season concludes shortly before the 18th, deciding final seeding.
    • Official Schedule: Final game times and dates will be updated on the official NHL Playoff Bracket page.
    • Ticketing: Tickets are already available for first-round games for teams like the Carolina Hurricanes. 
    Note: The 2025 playoffs took place from April 19 to June 17, 2025.
